title: 3.15 The Alphabet
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Say the 26 English letters in groups that share a sound and tell apart the letters that sound different in Spanish.
vocabulary: F, L, M, N, S, X
grammar_function: Letter names in sound groups; What is it? It is + letter.
prerequisite: 2.4 What is it?; 3.1 What is your name? My name is Ana.
speaking_outcome: Say the alphabet group by group, and answer What is it? with It is E., It is G. or It is W.
